as_told.title: Researcher visits Doty-linked sources and 'takes the bait'

plain: In 1982, the story goes, a man named Rick Doty got in touch with a UFO researcher named Linda Moulton Howe and showed her documents, among them papers about something called Project Garnet, said to be a secret government UFO project. Michels lays out the meeting himself in an episode with the writer Greg Bishop. He frames it as one researcher contacting another and does not say where he learned of it. Bishop adds a second-hand piece. He says he talked to Tom Adams, a researcher of cattle mutilations (unexplained killings of livestock), who told him Howe came to visit a couple of days later. According to Adams, she was "very excited" and "over the moon." If the papers were real, they would point to a hidden official programme. Michels gives the meeting, and Bishop gives Howe's mood afterwards as Adams described it to him.
